value.rationale: For the natural seven-symbol cycle confusability channel, maximal codebooks are exact terminal states of iterative zero-error code design. Although ten words are attainable, construction may stop at seven, and 82,201 of 83,181 endpoints (226 natural symmetry orbits) are suboptimal. Classifying the entire stopping-size distribution and symmetries, rather than just the already known extremal cardinalities or an arbitrary partial slice, is motivated finite coding information useful for comparing greedy terminal designs.
